_comment: Pinned helper binaries bundled into Muninn.app/Contents/Resources/bin. Every download is verified against these SHA-256 values; the build stops on a mismatch. To update a tool: change url + sha256 here (take the digest from the publisher's own checksum file) and rebuild. ffmpeg is the exception: it is compiled from the pinned source tarball (kind ffmpeg-lgpl-source) with an LGPL-only configuration, on an Apple Silicon Mac, because no reputable prebuilt LGPL-only macOS build exists.

yt-dlp.license: yt-dlp source: Unlicense; the standalone executable bundles third-party components (in the macOS build including mutagen, GPL-2.0-or-later, and certifi, MPL-2.0) and is run as a separate program; see licenses/yt-dlp-THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt
